flavorTemplates: {name} has changed hands more times than anyone still alive remembers.
Whoever made {name} clearly cared more about it working than it looking pretty.
There's a maker's mark on {name}, but nobody local recognizes the guild.
{name} has seen a fight or two, and it shows in the worn places.
{name} was clearly built to last, not to impress.
descriptionTemplates: A well-made piece, clearly built by someone who understood both form and function.
Shows real wear from use, but nothing about it has failed yet.
Simple in construction, effective in practice -- no wasted craftsmanship.
Marked with small, deliberate details that suggest a maker with real pride in the work.
Plain at a glance, but closer inspection turns up careful, unshowy craftsmanship.

Uncommon.value: Grants advantage on one saving throw of the wielder's choice once per short rest.
The wearer/wielder can sense the general direction of danger within 30 feet once per long rest.
Grants resistance to one damage type while worn, chosen when the item is first attuned.

Rare.value: Once per long rest, the wielder can reroll a failed attack roll or saving throw.
The item grants a +1 bonus to all saving throws.
Once per day, the wielder can cast a common utility spell without expending a spell slot.

Very Rare.value: The wielder gains resistance to two damage types of their choice, reassigned on a long rest.
Once per long rest, the item can negate one instance of damage entirely.

designNotes.value: Procedurally rolled from real 5e SRD weapon/armor base stats -- rarity, bonus, and flavor are template-generated, worth a manual polish pass.
